ad_intro:
Livspace (livspace.com) is a Home Interiors brand running ~60 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.2-4 Cr/mo and ads pointing to lead-form capture (sales team follows up). India's leading home-interiors platform, backed by KKR and Ingka (IKEA).

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: lead-form heavy, 3d walkthrough ugc gap - The gap: 3D walkthrough + before/after Reels. (2) Landing page: a lead form with no 3D walkthrough, cost transparency, or portfolio proof. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Enterprise lead in active scaling/cost mode - pitch efficiency and CVR, not more spend.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Lead-form heavy, 3D walkthrough UGC gap. The gap: 3D walkthrough + before/after Reels.
Copy leak: Current angle is lead-form capture-led. Missing angle: per-room price + timeline certainty over generic 'free design'.
Landing page leak: A lead form with no 3D walkthrough, cost transparency, or portfolio proof.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
competitors: 3D walkthrough + before/after Reels as ad creative.
3D/AR demos convert better than brochure leads.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy 3D walkthrough + before/after Reels
Shoot 15 fifteen-second 3D walkthrough + before/after Reels and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add a 3D/AR room visualizer, real project galleries, and transparent per-room pricing above the lead form. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
